title: Correctly calculate the elementSize when cache alignment is configured

timeline.message:
Correctly calculate the elementSize when cache alignment is configured

Motivation:

We need to take the cache alignment into account when we pre-calculate the ementSize otherwise we fail later.

Modifications:

- Fix pre-calculation
- Add unit test
- Fix incorrect unit test

Result:

Fixes https://github.com/netty/netty/issues/11955
timeline.author: Norman Maurer

strictly speaking this is not required by this change but while I did debug I noticed this can be final so I changed it within this PR
This test was incorrect. We should never return something < alignment
This was also not strictly needed but a bit more details helped to debug

The `PoolArena.HeapArena` is also getting the configured `directMemoryCacheAlignment` for some reason, which I don't think makes sense because then it will also modify the size tables for heap buffers.

reply.body: Fixed it by always using 0 when heap is used.

timeline.body: In the `main` branch, the new Buffer API has a copy of the `SizeClasses` class, where the memory overhead is reduced. That needs to get fixed as well. That can be done in the forward merge, or it can be done as a separate PR if it's too complicated, since it does have a couple of changes to reduce heap memory usage.
